comparison.objective: Hold a spring-loaded leaf aside while pouring water onto soil, then restore the scene.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual obstruction holding, controlled pouring, and spill/contamination avoidance.
comparison.success_condition: Current specs require at least 90 ml on soil, at most 10 ml on leaves, jug and leaf restored, arms returned, and 1 s stability.
comparison.reason: Tests liquid delivery around a compliant obstruction; shared bimanual coordination does not cover coaxial striking, fracture, or tiny rigid-fragment search.
